prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for specific kinds of change because no kind of change has at least 2 tests yet.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) hurt performance.
New home flows (home, new_flow) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly optimistic, especially for sign-in reordering where +20.0% was predicted but a loss occurred.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- home, new_flow: +2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Card Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen layout into a spotlight focus format with interactive choice cards for pre-made vs custom paths. (why: Choose path drops to 76.2% conversion with a high mean time of 514s, indicating initial hesitation when deciding how to proceed.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Sign In Notice: Add an explicit persistence hint and text component on the sign-in screen reassuring users that account linking saves their pet setup. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in, making account persistence clarity crucial.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Troubleshooting Copy Update: Update the sign-in headline and body to provide explicit guidance if screen loading or authentication stalls. (why: 2 support tickets noted that the sign-in screen does not appear or stalls, contributing to a 72.9% sign-in conversion rate.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status in Waiting Screen: Enable time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting screen with instructions for locating the pet on the desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or app failing to launch, while waiting screen median time is 201s.)
4: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Progress Stage Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a carousel layout with dynamic tip cards while rendering the companion engine. (why: The waiting phase has high mean duration (2336s), leading to user drop-off before reaching the finish step.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Guide: Rewrite the home_intro headline and hint to directly clarify how to interact with, hide, or control the pet. (why: 3 support tickets post-onboarding expressed confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Screen Companion Overview: Change home_intro layout to split view featuring interactive key control badges and a start button. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, showing the need for a clear visual hand-off into desktop usage.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Story Screen Path Teaser Incentive: Add pet animation components and copy teasers to the story screen to motivate path selection. (why: 76.2% conversion on choose_path indicates that reinforcing motivation early on the story screen will improve initial onboarding velocity.)
